objective: one bounded exposure test of corrected model-authored threat cover
stop_rule: retain first run at 12 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure, or independent episode end; no rerun
exposure_rule: report whether a visible-threat assessment authors non-coast next_cover and whether the exact policy executes during the next inference interval
acceptance_limit: mechanism acceptance requires linked next-turn execution, 10000ms complete-cycle compilation, verified release, and retained before/after frames; kill, health, or survival alone does not prove benefit
no_exposure_disposition: retain as unexposed and do not retry this allocation
